events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years On
events.blurb: On September 7, 1996, Tupac Shakur was shot in a drive-by shooting in Paradise, Nevada, and died six days later on September 13, 1996, at the age of 25.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years ago, we lost a true icon. Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 this year, left an indelible mark on music and culture. What's your favourite track from a legend gone too soon?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: 56 Years On
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix died on September 18, 1970, in London, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Hendrix's Influence
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84 this year. His influence on guitar music is still felt today. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: Abbey Road: 57 Years of The Beatles
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57! From that legendary zebra crossing to timeless tracks, it's an album that truly defined an era. What's your go-to song from the record?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of The Pretenders' frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, who turns 75 today.

angles.name: Hynde's Voice
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and fierce attitude have kept The Pretenders rocking for decades. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to the unmistakable voice of Oasis, Liam Gallagher.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem he fronted?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic song 'Imagine' in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago today, John Lennon released 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly now. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: The Original iPod: 25 Years Old
events.blurb: Apple released the first-generation iPod in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? The original iPod turns 25 today! It changed how we listened to music forever. What was the first song you loaded onto your iPod?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the anniversary of the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, everyone has a favourite. Who's your ultimate Bond and what's the best Bond song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Vision
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incomparable John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's his most impactful lyric for you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary British comedian and actor, John Cleese.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is timeless. What’s your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album': 58 Years On
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Diversity
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since its release, The Beatles' 'White Album' still surprises and delights. Its incredible range of styles makes it a true masterpiece. What's your hidden gem from the album?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 Years On
events.blurb: Remembering Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away 35 years ago today.

angles.name: Mercury's Magic
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost him, Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. He would have been 80 this year. What's the Queen song that always gives you chills?

events.title: Rubber Soul: 61 Years of The Beatles
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Sound
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul', an album that marked a significant shift in their sound. It's a classic for a reason! What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: John Lennon: 46 Years On
events.blurb: Commemorating the tragic death of music icon John Lennon, who was fatally shot in New York City in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His spirit lives on through his music and message of peace. What's the song of his that means the most to you?
